name: Resistance to burnout
description: A simulator for identifying signs of professional exhaustion and building healthy boundaries in the work process.

start.text: I can't anymore. Three weeks until two o'clock in the morning, and the tusks are not getting any less. Bored with code.

options.text: Complete exhaustion. What is taking the most strength now?
Such a schedule is a direct road to burnout. Talk to the manager.
We will all overtime. Your whining demotivates the team.
Terribly. But whatever you do, wait until the release...

emp_1.text: Reporting. PM requires reports for each step, it takes a lot of time.

options.text: I will help to automate the part. Do you agree?
Fill only critical fields. You will save an hour.
I understand, but I'm overwhelmed. get some sleep bye
Reporting is your responsibility. If you don't know how to plan, that's your problem.

neu_1.text: The manager says everything is a priority. Can't hear me.

options.text: Let's show him the real labor costs together.
Do as much as you can in 8 hours and turn off the laptop.
Managers are difficult. I hope you will decide. It's time for me.
You can't say no to ice - don't complain to others.

bad_1.text: Nagging?! I'm on the verge of a breakdown! You wouldn't be able to withstand such a pace!

options.text: Sorry, he said sharply. Let's reduce the load together.
I work no less, but I don't like tantrums.
Both are annoyed. Let's talk later.
I'm not going to listen. Do it yourself.

sad_1.text: To endure... I feel that I will fall tomorrow and not get up.

options.text: Take care of your health. Take at least a day of sick leave.
Well, if you fall, at least you will rest.
Sad situation. I hope you will find a way out. It's time for me.
your life Do whatever you want, I don't care.

emp_2.text: Logically. But I'm afraid the ice will think I'm not doing anything.

options.text: I will confirm that you work well.
Tasks are closed in Jira - no one reads the reports.
Why do you care who will think what? work
Maybe so... keep writing reports.

neu_2.text: I will try But if the release is delayed, they will make me the worst.

options.text: We are a team. If anything, I will protect you from the ice.
Fix the risks in the chat in advance.
If you are afraid of responsibility, change your profession.
Someone is always made the extreme... get ready.

bad_2.text: I ask for help, and in response - indifference and mockery!

options.text: Damage. Let's forget the argument and reduce the pressure.
No accusations. What tasks are burning?
Empathy won't close deadlines. Enough.
I tried to help, but I only hindered.

emp_3.text: Thank you, it became easier. But I still feel squeezed.

options.text: Normal after such a marathon. get some sleep
Relax on the weekend, turn off notifications.
I understand. It's time for me too. I advise you to rest.
Compassion cannot restore strength. go work

neu_3.text: Maybe so. I will try to record the risks and put the manager in front of the fact.

options.text: The right step. Now rest.
Lock and turn off the laptop. The rest will wait.
It has been resolved. I am leaving the network. Until Monday.
Fixed and satisfied? Well, well.

bad_3.text: forget it No one cares. I will plow until I drop.

options.text: I have business. Let's look at the list of tusks.
work But when you get laid, don't blame others.
You can't think right now. get some sleep
As you wish Not my problem.

emp_4.text: I will try to close the laptop right now. Thank you.

options.text: Perfectly! Have a good sleep!
come on Rest properly.
Finally agreed...
It would have been like this, instead of whining.

neu_4.text: OK, you're right. I turn off the laptop and go to bed. See you on Monday.

options.text: Right. Have a peaceful weekend!
See you on Monday.
The work is done. All the best.
I did it and it's good, less problems...

bad_4.text: You are selfish. I'm sorry for reaching out.

options.text: Sorry, nerves. Let's see what we can get out of you.
Let's leave the insults. You need to rest.
Why does trying to talk make me selfish?
Sorry as much as you want. Sneeze.

emp_5.text: The laptop turned off. I feel relief. Thank you.

options.text: Glad! Have a nice weekend!
Perfectly. Until Monday.
Closed the chat. Bye!
I hope you won't whine anymore.

neu_5.text: I am offline. I hope I get some sleep.

options.text: Necessarily. Have a nice rest!
See you soon.
Good luck Disconnecting
Finally. Less spam.

bad_5.text: That's it, I'm out. Don't write anymore.

options.text: OK, rest. On Monday.
With pleasure. Fewer complaints.
Everyone needs to cool down.
Disappear altogether.

good_end.text: You helped a colleague recognize burnout and maintain health.

neutral_end.text: The colleague rested, but the sediment from the conversation remained.

bad_end.text: Contact lost. A colleague is working on the verge of exhaustion.

kind_exit.text: You distanced yourself from someone else's burnout, saving your strength.

rude_exit.text: You interrupted the conversation, increasing the helplessness of your colleague.
